title: Cole Orloff Portfolio
description: Minimal design and development portfolio illustrating elegant interactions, strict grids, and premium type choices.
comment: Incredible page loading transitions and typography constraints. A masterclass in minimal light theme layout.

title: Chrome Tip: Search Tabs Quickly
description: Type '@tabs' in the Chrome address bar to search through open tabs instantly without leaving your keyboard.
comment: Absolute game-changer for tab hoarders. Instantly indexes all open windows.

title: Material 3 Design System
description: Google's open-source design system, providing components, guidelines, and tools to help teams build premium products.
comment: Super clean component elevation rules, dynamic HSL color matching, and typography grids.

title: GitHub Copilot Workspace
description: A natural language developer environment that helps you build features, write tests, and fix bugs in a structured workspace.
comment: The agentic software development workflow is arriving rapidly. Incredibly fast iteration loops.

title: Spotify Design Journal
description: A repository of stories, research, and reflections from the design community at Spotify sharing product design guidelines.
comment: Interesting thoughts on designing for personalization, user playlists, and listener moods.

title: Chrome Tip: Auto Tab Groups
description: Right click a tab and select 'Add tab to new group'. Organize your active research topics in separate visual clusters.
comment: Helps declutter workspaces. Pro tip: you can name and color-code groups to hide/expand folders.

title: SynthID: AI Content Watermarking
description: Google DeepMind's tool for watermarking and identifying AI-generated content by embedding digital watermarks directly into AI outputs.
comment: Really interesting technology. Embedding imperceptible watermarks into model weights to ensure content safety.

title: Histogram Digital Studio
description: A premium visual studio creating highly interactive digital design experiences, spatial layout, and brand systems.
comment: Stunning grid-based typography constraints and interactive cursor physics. A beautiful reference for web layouts.

title: NFP 73: Circular Economy Visualizer
description: An interactive data platform exploring economic flows, resource consumption, and sustainable finance visual guidelines.
comment: A premium reference for data visualization layout. Clean, interactive maps and responsive SVG node structures.

title: Chrome Tip: Create Custom Site Search Shortcuts
description: Set up keywords in Settings > Search engines to query your favorite sites (like '@figma filename') directly from the omnibox.
comment: Huge time saver. Search Figma files, Github repositories, or internal docs in seconds without opening the homepage.
